name: Productive requirements and coupled reaction account
description: Represent cofactors, substrates, electron/nucleotide donors and compatible partners required for productive operation, distinguishing coupled consumption from merely correlated stimulation.
claim_scope: A productive reaction or repeated operation in a stated system, keeping incomplete preparation, single event, sustained turnover and coupled readout distinct.
distinctions: Regulatory stimulation versus consumed coupled substrate.
Upstream capacity versus downstream partner-admitted specificity.
Single event or ATP hydrolysis versus sustained productive operation.
Artificial donor substitution versus identified native supply.

example_structured_values.meaning: Finite examples of declared values/reference types, not a complete ontology, numerical credit scale, adopted scoring axis or claim of existing runtime compatibility.

not_established: Required assay reagent does not identify native partner.
Coupled precursor preference is not isolated upstream specificity.
Feasibility/balance does not establish native flux or proton translocation.
Ideal extrapolated stoichiometry is not a measured uncertain ratio.
boundary: A03 addresses mechanism. A04 records requirements/accounting. A05 is an input-to-regulatory-effect relation, not inferred merely from a substrate requirement.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record actual_observations and annotation_consequence; recorded inspection scope: Relevant purification, reconstitution, activity/complementation methods, cofactor results and EPR interpretation inspected; raw spectra not reprocessed.
evidence.observation: Iron/sulfide restoration alone is insufficient; cobalamin restoration enables productive oQ-to-Q conversion.
evidence.limit: Artificial donors do not identify native electron delivery; raw spectra not reprocessed.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record actual_observations and annotation_consequence; recorded inspection scope: Relevant expression/reconstitution/assay methods, results, stoichiometry figures and discussion inspected; supplements not independently reanalyzed.
evidence.observation: NAD+-stimulated ferredoxin reduction resolves as coupled transhydrogenation with reverse dependence and stoichiometry.
evidence.limit: Native NADPH-supply interpretation is not new flux measurement; analytical bounds remain.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record actual_observations and annotation_consequence; recorded inspection scope: Full relevant introduction, purification/assay methods, results, tables and discussion inspected; raw HTML and parsed paragraphs saved.
evidence.observation: Consumed crotonyl-CoA enables the defined ferredoxin-reduction system, replacing an apparent acetyl-CoA activation explanation.
evidence.limit: Measured ratios are 2.2 NADH and 1.4 crotonyl-CoA per H2; ideal 2:1:1 is extrapolated.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record actual_observations and annotation_consequence; recorded inspection scope: Relevant full primary results/discussion and assay/LC-MS/crystallography methods inspected in all three papers. No new flux measurements, crystallographic refinement or spectrum fitting.
evidence.observation: Changing only downstream CofD/FbiA changes apparent upstream precursor preference, so isolated promiscuity and pathway entry differ.
evidence.limit: Cognate organism-specific pairs do not establish universal CofC PEP specificity or new native flux.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record actual_observations and annotation_consequence; recorded inspection scope: Complete main experimental procedures and relevant results read from full PMC HTML; supplementary procedures not independently inspected. No new sequence/fusion search or assays.
evidence.observation: ATP regeneration abolishes bacterial repair activity, motivating ADP testing and ADP-dependent dehydratase assignment.
evidence.limit: ATP dependence cannot transfer from eukaryotic homologs; supplementary procedures not independently read.
